How much is a Thai cooking class on Koh Samui? | Our small-group garden-kitchen class costs 2,000 THB per person in 2026, with transfer from the main tourist areas. Resort-style schools sold on international booking sites start at about 4,200 THB with a private transfer.
How long is a cooking class on Samui? | About 2.5–3 hours of cooking and eating, plus transfer. Our morning class runs from about 09:30 pickup to 13:00, and the afternoon class starts at 14:30.
Can vegetarians and vegans join a Samui cooking class? | Yes. Soy sauce replaces fish sauce and tofu or mushrooms replace meat; the hidden ingredient is shrimp paste in curry paste, so tell us when you book and the cook will prepare a paste without it.
Is there a market tour on the Koh Samui cooking class? | On our class, a stop at a local fresh market is optional on the way, before the garden tour and herb picking. On your own, the Lamai fresh market opens about 06:00–20:00 and is best before 09:00.
Can children take part in a Thai cooking class on Samui? | Usually, yes, with an adult cooking alongside because of gas burners and knives. Tell us the children's ages when you enquire and we confirm the minimum age, or book a private family session.
Does the cooking class include a transfer from my hotel? | Yes, return transfer is included from the main tourist areas of Koh Samui. Remote accommodation may pay a small surcharge, which we confirm before you book.
Do I get the recipes after the class? | Yes, our class includes a recipe booklet to take home, covering the starters, curry paste and mains you cooked.
Which dishes are unique to Koh Samui? | Wai khua, octopus cooked in coconut milk, is Samui's signature dish. Southern classics include gaeng som or gaeng lueang (sour turmeric curry), khua kling (dry-fried mince with curry paste) and gaeng tai pla.
How many people are in your cooking class? | Up to 4 guests, each at their own station. Private groups of 5–7 can be arranged on request.
Is a cooking class a good rainy-day activity on Koh Samui? | Yes, it is the classic one. The kitchens are covered, and a morning class fills the time while October to December downpours pass; plan a boat trip for the next clear day.
